name: Thanksgiving Bingo!
raw: Thanksgiving Bingo! | Wednesday, November 25, 2026 6:00 PM |  Join us for an evening of family-friendly fun at our Thanksgiving Bingo! Enjoy classic bingo games, win small prizes, and share lots of laughs. Bring your lucky charms and get ready to shout BINGO!

name: Celebrate the Season with Stella the Sloth!
raw: Celebrate the Season with Stella the Sloth! | Thursday, December 3, 2026 6:00 PM |  Join us as we welcome Animal Quest for the Stella the Sloth Experience! This is a unique opportunity to meet a real sloth in person and learn all about these fascinating creatures. Let's take a cue from the sloth and start our holiday season slowly, embracing every special moment. Following the presentation, we will have Christmas cookies, hot chocolate, and a Christmas card-making station. Please register for each person attending.

name: Art Zone
raw: Art Zone | Monday, December 7, 2026 6:00 PM |  Come hang out and have fun creating colorful craft projects. Craft: Holiday String Art Tree Make a string art tree using nails and wood.

name: Homeschool Art Class
raw: Homeschool Art Class | Thursday, December 10, 2026 10:00 AM |  Artist: ​Rembrandt Harmenszoon van Rijn Rembrandt was a Dutch Golden Age painter, printmaker and draughtsman renowned for his dramatic use of light emerging from the deep shadows. Create your own holiday print that contrasts light with darkness.

name: Santa & Mrs. Claus is Coming to the Library!
raw: Santa & Mrs. Claus is Coming to the Library! | Saturday, December 19, 2026 1:00 PM |  Enjoy a magical holiday event featuring a story read by Santa and Mrs. Claus, photo opportunities, festive letter-writing, and fun seasonal crafts. Please register for each person attending.

name: Let's Make Buddy the Elf Christmas Snack Mix!
raw: Let's Make Buddy the Elf Christmas Snack Mix! | Monday, December 21, 2026 1:00 PM |  Join us for a fun activity mixing Elf's favorite food groups: candy, candy canes, candy corn, and maple syrup! Participants will enjoy a sample of their creation before adding the mix to gift bags to take home.
